contract.semantics: Declared-tenant reservation in MB. When set, the runner adds it to the WEIZIGO_HOST_MEM_AVAIL_MB reading (available-to-the-fleet = available + reservation) before comparing against the danger floor; the host guard fires only when available-to-the-fleet < floor. Unset ⇒ production behaviour, byte-identical to today. Parallel to the existing WEIZIGO_HOST_MEM_AVAIL_MB injection hook — the floor is never tested by exhausting the host.
